product_metadata.title: Fox Run Wooden Crab Mallet, 8 x 2.25 x 1.25 inches, Brown
features: PREMIUM NATURAL BEECHWOOD makes this the ideal crab cracker for the discerning chef or home cook. It also features an attractive wood handle design to marry style and function.
LIGHTWEIGHT: Designed to be just strong enough to crack shell without mashing it.
SECURE YOUR SEAFOOD: Perfect for lobster, crab and other shellfish.
EASY TO CLEAN: Simply wash by hand so that it may serve you well for many years to come.
MEASUREMENTS: This mallet weighs 1.6 ounces and has dimensions of 8 x 2.25 x 1.25 inches.
description: Make sure you're properly equipped for your next shellfish feast! Constructed of durable beech wood, Nantucket Seafood's Crab Mallet features a necessary lightweight design, allowing you to crack the shell without shattering it and ruining your long-awaited meal. To use and avoid crushing, begin gently tapping the shell with the mallet, increasing force until shell is cracked. Perfect for lobster claws, crab legs and other shellfish, so you can enjoy all the goodness inside.
